regulation_clause.text: If a complainant does not get satisfactory response from the card-issuer within a maximum period of one month from the date of lodging the complaint, he/she will have the option to approach the Office of the concerned RBI Ombudsman.

gold.gold_rationale: The 2022 clause allows a maximum period of 'one month' before Ombudsman escalation eligibility. 2000-DUE-DATE computes a due date exactly one calendar month after the complaint date (with correct December-to-January year rollover at lines 34-36), and 3000-COMPARE escalates only when the check date exceeds that due date. This directly and correctly implements a one-calendar-month maximum period.
